notes.title: Steam release, Spotify release + Steam Playtest!
notes.content:
I have finally finished up everything needed to release the game on steam. All that is left is the remaining time to develop and release Jones on both itch.io and steam for FREE. I have expanded and will add basic features like saving and cloud saving so players won't lose progress.

I'm expanding the game to be about at least an hour, with a new linear story set in the perspective of a highschool aged girl. Players must navigate through real environments of the characters daily life while also going through the void for personal segments. The player has choices that will alter the direction of the story, and will leave consequences. It's a personalized story that hopefully can relate or inform the player.

I'm happy to announce that Jones will be releasing August 1st, for free on itch.io and steam. The soundtrack is also released on Spotify if you guys care to give it a listen!

The prototype and playtesting will only be available on Steam however just for easier management of Quality control, but nonetheless, when it's ready. It'll be released here.

Thank you so much for following the development process, I will hopefully see you in 5 weeks.

Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/artist/6gOylJecVg4N24hiUsSvO0

Steam DEMO + Playtest signup: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2059200/Jones/

Thank you!

- Mario Egocheaga
